prompt:
We're a genomics engineering team building a Python-based variant processing pipeline. We've been struggling with AI coding agents (we use Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot simultaneously) all starting fresh every session — they keep re-discovering the same bugs, forgetting our conventions, and contradicting each other's decisions.

I've found a solution called 'agent-context-system' that's already been installed in the workspace under the skills directory. The session history notes I've left in SESSION_HISTORY_NOTES.txt summarize what we've learned across our last four working sessions.

Please set up the full persistent agent context system for our project. The system should capture our actual project knowledge, conventions, and accumulated learnings from those session notes. Pay special attention to any patterns that have come up repeatedly — those need to be flagged appropriately so I can decide whether to officially adopt them. Make sure the setup works correctly for Claude Code specifically (it has a quirky way it reads its config), and make sure personal scratchpad data never accidentally ends up in version control.
